column1: # ambiguity.tsv: decisions for English words whose Telex typing is an attested Vietnamese syllable (spec/01-engine.md 8.3).
# Rule L11: decision en -> restore the raw keys, vi -> keep the Vietnamese display. Keyed by the exact lowercased raw keys
# (ENG-R822: another key order stays typable, e.g. tets -> tét).
# status: proposed = ENG-R821 starting decision (applies as written until Pa confirms), reviewed = decided by Pa,
# unreviewed = generated candidate nobody has decided yet; behaves as vi whatever the decision column says (ENG-R821).
# Candidates come from `lexicon-builder ambiguity-candidates --merge` (ENG-R820). Pa reviews at least the 300 most frequent.
# The merge adds vi/unreviewed rows, except en/proposed for English words whose display is not attested (rule L8
# restores them before this table is read) and for tech-always words (rule L11 restores them without a row);
# those generated en rows go to the last block, "# [generated en rows]", and `lexicon-builder build` fails when
# the reason recorded in their note no longer holds. See docs/decisions/0202 and data/derived/ambiguity-candidates.tsv.
# Columns are tab-separated. Lines starting with '#' are comments.
